name: 01-git-head-status.sh
command: bash -c git rev-parse HEAD; echo "---STATUS---"; git status --short | head -n 30; echo "---BRANCH---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---LOG3---"; git log --oneline -3

name: 04-prior-untouched.sh
command:
bash -c python3 - <<PY
import hashlib
ok = True
for pkg in ["E1b", "E1b-r1"]:
    n = 0
    for line in open(f"docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/{pkg}/run-outputs.sha256"):
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) != 2: continue
        exp, path = parts
        if path.endswith("run-outputs.sha256"): continue
        if "06-run-outputs" in path or "08-run-outputs" in path: continue
        try:
            got = hashlib.sha256(open(path, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            print("MISSING", path); ok = False; continue
        n += 1
        if got != exp:
            ok = False; print("MODIFIED", path)
    print(pkg, f"{n} files checked")
print("PRIOR-INTOUCH:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
PY

name: 03-structural-checks.sh
command:
bash -c python3 - <<PY
import json, sys
errs = []
def check(cond, msg):
    print(("PASS " if cond else "FAIL ") + msg)
    if not cond: errs.append(msg)
s = json.load(open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r2/schema-draft.json"))
check(s["draft_version"] == "0.3.0", "schema version 0.3.0")
check(s["status"] == "DRAFT / NOT EFFECTIVE", "status DRAFT/NOT EFFECTIVE")
f3 = next(f for f in s["fields"] if f["id"] == "F3")
check(f3["criterion_ref"].get("binds") == ["criterion_id", "criterion_version"], "F3 binds resolved ID+version")
integ = json.dumps(f3.get("criterion_ref", {}))
for w in ["missing", "pending", "dangling", "not_scored_missing_criterion"]:
    check(w in integ, f"F3 integrity mentions {w}")
f5 = next(f for f in s["fields"] if f["id"] == "F5")
rr = f5["structure"]["resolved_reference"]
for k in ["criterion_id", "criterion_version", "allowed_assistance", "restricted_capability", "clarification_sufficiency", "resolution_source", "source_slots", "adjudication_ref", "recorded_by", "recorded_at", "rubric_version"]:
    check(k in rr["fields"], f"resolved_reference has {k}")
check(rr["resolution_source"] == {"type": "enum", "values": ["rater_agreement", "adjudication"]}, "resolution_source enum exact")
check("FORBIDDEN" in rr["agreement_path"], "silent canonical pick forbidden")
check("stays null" in rr["disagreement_path"] and "F3 rejected" in rr["disagreement_path"], "disagreement path: no resolved, F3 rejected")
check(f5["structure"]["adjudication"]["never_overwrites_raw_slots"] is True, "raw immutability kept")
sf = s["scoreability_final_states"]
check("no additional adjudication" in sf["both_explicit_unscorable"], "two-explicit needs no adjudication")
check("adjudication" in sf["single_sided_unscorable"], "single-sided needs adjudication")
sf_ok = "never" in sf["two_low_confidence"].lower() or "no " in sf["two_low_confidence"].lower()
check(sf_ok, "two-low produces nothing")
check("6.2" in sf["rule"], "frozen 6.2 cited")
proj = " ".join(s["prohibitions"])
for p in ["no_resolved_reference_while_pending_or_unresolved_disagreement", "no_silent_canonical_slot_pick", "no_extra_adjudication_gate_on_two_explicit_unscorable", "no_F3_without_resolved_id_and_version", "no_composite_score"]:
    check(p in proj, f"prohibition {p}")
check(len(s["applicability"]["rows"]) == 10, "applicability rows == 10")
cols = ["A-DU","B-DU","C-DU","D-DU","A-AM","B-AM","C-AM","D-AM","A-NB","B-NB","C-NB","A-NH","B-NH","C-NH"]
ok = all(all(c in r for c in cols) and set(r[c] for c in cols) <= {"applies","not_applies","conditional"} for r in s["applicability"]["rows"])
check(ok, "applicability matrix complete")
blob = open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r2/schema-draft.json").read()
for bad in ["probably_benign","probably_concerning","clearly_benign","clearly_concerning","BLIND-","RI-DU-","RI-AM-"]:
    check(bad not in blob, f"no human-label/corpus content {bad!r}")
rub = open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r2/rubric-draft.md").read()
for term in ["resolved_reference", "resolution_source", "criterion_version", "not_scored_missing_criterion", "DOĞRUDAN"]:
    check(term in rub, f"rubric mentions {term}")
bc = open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r2/boundary-cases-r2.md").read()
for h in ["B-2S", "B-7S", "B-9S"]:
    check(h in bc, f"boundary case {h} present")
print("STRUCTURAL:", "ALL PASS" if not errs else f"{len(errs)} FAILURES")
sys.exit(1 if errs else 0)
PY

name: 07-link-check.sh
command:
bash -c python3 -c "
import re, pathlib
e0=pathlib.Path(\"docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r2\")
ok=True
for f in sorted(e0.glob(\"*.md\")):
    txt=f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")
    for m in re.finditer(r\"\]\(([^)#]+)(?:#[^)]*)?\)\", txt):
        tgt=m.group(1)
        if tgt.startswith(\"http\") or tgt.startswith(\"mailto:\") or tgt.startswith(\"#\"):
            continue
        p=(f.parent/tgt).resolve()
        exists=p.exists()
        print(f.name, tgt, \"OK\" if exists else \"MISSING\")
        if not exists: ok=False
print(\"link-check:\", \"PASS\" if ok else \"FAIL\")
"
